nalli:10068562084139.description:
This half-and-half saree blends tradition with modern elegance. Gold half-tissue pleats offer subtle shimmer, while black Pure silk organza features spaced chintz florals. Delicate gold line art adds depth, enhancing the striking contrast of
bright blooms against the dark fabric for a refined and balanced look.

nalli:10068536426795.description: Inspired by daffodils and pressed flowers, this saree captures nostalgic beauty with clean white lines tracing delicate floral curves. Golden zari accents enhance contrast, while bold blooms on the pallu add drama. Crafted in pure silk organza with digitally printed, hand illustrations. it features a gold beaded trim and zari embroidery in the pallu.

nalli:10068549370155.description: Crafted in tussar blend, this saree showcases hand-illustrated lilies transitioning from buds to bold blooms. A woven zari border and pallu with extra weft detailing enhance its elegance. Digital printing adds depth, while the minimal gold and pearl border offers a refined finishing touch.

nalli:10068540653867.description: This design reflects the intricate beauty of Indian miniature paintings, with detailed trees set against a dark background for striking contrast. Fine linework adds depth, while vibrant colors enhance each tree’s charm. Crafted in organza with digitally printed, hand illustrations. It features a gold beaded trim for an elegant finish.

nalli:10068550680875.description: Crafted in shades of pink, this saree features hand-painted prints of lily flowers, gradually becoming denser near the border to form a defined pallu. Made from light, airy organza, it offers a soft, flowing drape perfect for summer while symbolising purity and innocence.

nalli:10068536820011.description:
Crafted in organza with delicate pearl-trimmed gold accents, this saree is a modern interpretation of the chinoiserie art style, featuring peacocks, parrots, and swallows amidst flowing trees and lush foliage. It captures the essence of a
vibrant Indian forest with delicate flowers, evoking the spirit of summer and spring.
tags: Cotton & Organza Sarees | Designed by Nalli

nalli:10068541079851.description: This design reflects the intricate beauty of Indian miniature paintings, with detailed trees set against a dark background for striking contrast. Fine linework adds depth, while vibrant colors enhance each tree’s charm. Crafted in pure silk organza with digitally printed, hand illustrations. It features a gold beaded trim for an elegant finish.

nalli:10068537671979.description: Inspired by the majestic allure of peacocks in Mughal art, this saree captures their regal charm and cultural depth. Digitally printed on luxurious organza, it features intricate embroidery and a sequins-embroidered trim. It pays tribute to India’s artistic legacy while exuding grandeur, beauty, and timeless grace.

nalli:10068556808491.description: Crafted in tissue with a zari border, this saree draws inspiration from traditional chintz. Stylised florals and flowing motifs in pink and green create a seamless design on a light background, celebrating the rich heritage and global influence of Indian chintz textiles.
tags: Cotton & Organza Sarees | Designed by Nalli

nalli:10068548518187.description: Inspired by the chrysanthemum, a symbol of longevity and beauty, this saree features a botanical jaal pattern on a teal backdrop with pops of pink. A textured fabric with a woven zari border adds elegance, ensuring a graceful drape that captures the flower’s timeless charm and cultural significance.

nalli:10068546715947.description: Crafted in organza, this saree blends Mughal artistry with modern elegance. Delicate floral motifs framed by a gold trellis echo the era’s opulence. Digitally printed, hand illustrations, zari embroidery on the body and pallu and a gold beaded trim enhance its luxurious appeal, evoking opulence and romance.

nalli:10068537311531.description: Crafted from pure silk organza with delicate pearl-trimmed gold accents, this saree is a modern interpretation of the chinoiserie art style, featuring peacocks, parrots, and swallows amidst flowing trees and lush foliage. It captures the essence of a vibrant Indian forest with delicate flowers, evoking the spirit of summer and spring.

nalli:10062939193643.description: The Vanasingaaram Kanchipuram silk saree, woven in 165 handloom hours, features Vanasingaram patterns on the body, a floral twill border, and a pallu adorned with golden floral and reku motifs. Handcrafted in four-ply pure silk, it drapes beautifully, making it perfect for auspicious occasions.

nalli:10062083752235.description: The Mayilkan Kanchipuram silk saree, woven in 170 handloom hours, features lover peacock motifs on the body, a twill border, and a petni pallu with peacock designs. Handcrafted in four-ply pure silk, it offers a fine drape, perfect for auspicious occasions.

nalli:10061121618219.description: The Aaditi Kanchipuram silk saree, crafted in 165 handloom hours, features floral and deer motifs on the body. The thalampu creeper border adds elegance, while the pallu is adorned with traditional floral brooch designs. A timeless weave, perfect for celebrating heritage and tradition.

nalli:10057492169003.description: The Malligai Kanchipuram silk saree takes 275 handloom weaving hours, featuring a korvai border and petni pallu. Handcrafted in four-ply pure silk, it showcases malligai butta motifs on the body, mayilkan and geometric florals on the border, and stylized malligai floral designs on the pallu.

nalli:10057490989355.description: The Mrignayani Kanchipuram silk saree is handwoven over 165 hours in four-ply pure silk for a fine drape. Deer motifs adorn the body, floral thalampu creepers grace the border, and the pallu features intricate talaisaman designs, reflecting timeless craftsmanship and elegance.

nalli:10061240009003.description: Experience harmony in the Bhumi Light Blue Banarasi Saree, adorned with floral zari buta in a half-drop pattern. The zari border, featuring floral arrangements, mirrors the sober pallu with seamless floral vines. Intricate embellishments and a delicate flower bouquet motif enhance the elegance, creating a beautifully balanced drape.

nalli:10071729144107.description:
Kamala draws from rare archival two-pallu Kanjeevaram designs. One pallu features sacred kamalam motifs, rudraksha pet borders & rich zari bands. The other showcases handwoven thazhampoo reku with delicate butis. Golden kamalam butis appear melted into the silk body with precision.

nalli:10090937811243.description: This pure korwai silk saree with gold zari strikes a graceful balance. The cream body is adorned with subtle kamalam butas, while the pastel green asymmetric borders feature kamalam kattam, mayil motifs and a rare maan inspired by the Ramayana. The pallu shines with pavun (coin) motifs and zari lines, finished in a sharp and regal composition.

nalli:10090937844011.description: Sandhya captures evening's regal beauty with dynamic mayil butas in borders above delicate temple motifs. Pure mulberry silk body features tiny kamalam butas in half-step repeat. The pallu showcases cohesive kamalam butas, mayilkann, and mayil motifs woven in rich golden zari. Handwoven perfection.

nalli:10090937975083.description: Saroja offers fresh interpretation of timeless Palum Pazhamum design with new colour combinations and kamalam butas across the body. Ornate corner konia motifs depict two deer and peacock within double-paisley grid. Rich traditional pallu and 3.5-inch ghetti border with button thuthrippu complete.
tags: Koadu Kattam and Half  - Half Fine/Without Zari

nalli:10090938040619.description: Aabha reinterprets the rare classic patli pallu design with pleats woven in contrasting colour. Features striking killi and kamalam bands in pleats against contrasting hues. Understated body with small butis accentuates pleat drama and pallu richness. Delicate manga border completes this rare design.
tags: Koadu Kattam and Half  - Half Fine/Without Zari

nalli:10090938302763.description: Amaaya combines alternating vertical lines with handwoven butas, creating rhythmic textures. Mayil butas feature across the body with kamalam pet, dhavanakodi, and rudraksh motifs. Contrasting silk bands add vibrancy. Temple borders frame with restraint. Pallu showcases structured ghetti composition.

nalli:10090938335531.description: Gauri features classic double border with delicately woven rudraksh pet in gold zari using korwai technique. Striking beet-buta depicts simha yaali, mythical temple guardian with dragon body and lion head. Grand pallu showcases thilakam moku, mayilkann ghetti, rudraksh, and simha yaali motifs.

nalli:10176046072107.description: The 'Mayilkan' Kanjeevaram silk saree from our Alankar collection celebrates the peacock, a symbol of grace and beauty. The body features intricate mayil motifs, while the lower half and border weave peacocks amid delicate florals. A subtle twill border frames the saree, and the pallu echoes the same detailing, completing it with quiet elegance.

nalli:10176046170411.description: The 'Lasya' Kanjeevaram silk saree from our Indira collection embodies a graceful balance of form and detail. Its body features alternating floral butas, a bold tree-like motif and a delicate single bloom. The border carries a flowing floral vine framed by ghetti band and muthu seeru. A rich ghetti pallu brings these elements together with elegance and continuity.

nalli:10176046268715.description: Our 'Aaditi' Kanjeevaram saree from the Alankar collection is handwoven in four-ply pure silk, giving it a graceful, fluid drape. The body is richly detailed with brocade work featuring graceful deer woven among delicate floral vines, with thazhampoo creepers rising from the rich zari ghetti border, and a pair of deer placed within the pallu's ghetti panels for a balanced finish.

nalli:10176046498091.description: Ballari, from our Sangam collection, is an expression of classic Kanjeevaram craftsmanship, handwoven over 165 hours in 4-ply pure silk. It features a contemporary borderless design, with the body adorned in fine floral brocade motifs and a striking contrast petni pallu. The bold pallu is finished with rich ghetti panels, lending a beautifully balanced harmony to the design.

nalli:10176046530859.description: The Anudhyana Kanjeevaram saree from our Indira collection honours cultural heritage through classic motifs. Its body features traditional Rudraksh symbols, while the border carries graceful Annapakshi patterns divided by slender Rudraksh Pet stripes. The grand pallu unites the design with alternating bands of Annapakshi and Rudraksh.

nalli:10176046563627.description: The 'Aparajita' Kanjeevaram silk saree from our Indira collection highlights traditional weaving through refined detailing. Its plain silk body contrasts gracefully with a korvai border featuring small thazhampoo reku temple motifs and delicate floral zari. The contrasting ghetti pallu carries these floral elements and frames into a honeycomb design in gold-zari.
